dibData.default: [{"role":"Prime Contractors (Tier 1)","trigger":"Direct contract award from NAVAIR, NAVSEA, USAF, Army with DFARS 252.204-7021.","level":"Level 2 / Level 3 Certification","firstStep":"Enterprise CUI boundary segmentation & formal mock DIBCAC defense."},{"role":"Subcontractors & Component Makers (Tier 2-3)","trigger":"Flowdown clauses in purchase orders from Boeing, Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, General Dynamics.","level":"Level 2 (3-Year C3PAO Audit)","firstStep":"On-site facility inspection, SPRS score calculation, and enclave scoping."},{"role":"Build-to-Print Precision Machine Shops","trigger":"DoD technical engineering drawings, CAD models, and specs marked as CUI.","level":"Level 2 (Scoping Boundary Crucial)","firstStep":"Isolate shop floor CNC controllers and build a secure enclave for CAD files."},{"role":"Defense Software, MSPs & Cloud SaaS","trigger":"Hosting, processing, or transmitting DoD data under DFARS 252.204-7012.","level":"Level 2 + FedRAMP Moderate Equivalency","firstStep":"Verify FedRAMP High/Moderate baseline and configure cloud identity boundary."}]
